role: The base player entity: inventory and held item, the item-in-use (eating, bow) flow, hunger and experience, damage and death, dropping items, sleeping in beds, attacking, and the XP bar.
scope_reason: The played entity on both sides; the native engine keeps both a client and a server player in the oracle's lockstep order (SPEC 'Two sides, like the game').

notes: Members marked n/a are out of the replayed scope (render cosmetics, sounds, chat, switched-off features) rather than ported. The GUI openers all funnel through survival.c's gui_open_tile/gui_open_merchant; enchanting, anvil, beacon, brewing, horse and hopper screens are n/a per world.conf. The canEat citation points at the use-packet path because the predicate is inlined there; not verified as a standalone symbol. lane/idxentity: the missing list was stale or out of play: the scoreboard and teams need commands or a second player, fishing is switched off, handleHealthUpdate(9) is client_on_item_use_finish, the fly toggle needs creative. addToPlayerScore and onKillEntity are now called separately with Java's two entities (ent-kill-s1). lane/reloadstate: attackEntityFrom keeps a shooterless arrow as the source entity, so its knockback comes from the arrow (serverreplay.c sr_player_attack).
